Our own [llms.txt](https://docs.broadcastwell.com/llms.txt), in the published 3 November 2026 snapshot, begins with `# Broadcastwell` and supplies a source guide. The site separately publishes [robots.txt](https://docs.broadcastwell.com/robots.txt) declarations for Googlebot and Google-Extended. These are different artifacts: a maintained guide is not itself a crawler permission, and its presence cannot override Google's stated Search eligibility requirements. This exact file reading establishes publication, without evidence that a search system fetched or used it.

## What we measured

description.new: No. Google's guidance for AI features in Search asks for no special AI file; llms.txt is optional.
description.old: Google does not require special AI files; Housecall Pro's 43/150 own-domain citation count does not test llms.txt.
